entries: Fell + Affe. Affe has been occasionally employed with bag meaning since the early 19ᵗʰ century according to Kluge; earlier parallels include the Katzbalg of the Landsknechte.
senses: a kind of furry knapsack, standard in the Switzerland military and with some Wehrmacht and SS units in 1930–1950
to concrete; to solidify (of ideas, proposals, plans, etc.)
strong/mixed nominative/accusative neuter singular of sprichwörtlich
